_comment: Local-only launcher bindings. Copy/edit as tools/guardian/scheduler.config.json; the file is gitignored and must never contain secrets.
_usage: Version 2 keeps independent bindings under projects keyed by canonical target path. Explicit -TargetRepo selects only that project; no-arg launch uses last_target_repo. Each project asks once for strict/worktree mode and remembers it independently. Legacy v1 single-binding JSON remains readable and migrates on the next write. -Yes cannot invent a missing choice; -DryRun fails closed.
